SELECT cr.relationship_id, r.relationship_name, c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.domain_id, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_class_id, c.standard_concept, c.concept_code, CAST(c.valid_start_date AS VARCHAR) AS valid_start_date, CAST(c.valid_end_date AS VARCHAR) AS valid_end_date, c.invalid_reason FROM concept_relationship cr JOIN concept c ON c.concept_id = cr.concept_id_2 LEFT JOIN relationship r ON r.relationship_id = cr.relationship_id WHERE cr.concept_id_1 = 103 AND (cr.invalid_reason IS NULL OR cr.invalid_reason = '') ORDER BY cr.relationship_id, c.concept_name, c.concept_id LIMIT 10000

SELECT c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.domain_id, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_class_id, c.standard_concept, c.concept_code, CAST(c.valid_start_date AS VARCHAR) AS valid_start_date, CAST(c.valid_end_date AS VARCHAR) AS valid_end_date, c.invalid_reason, h.level AS hierarchy_level FROM (SELECT ca.ancestor_concept_id AS concept_id, -MIN(ca.min_levels_of_separation) AS level FROM concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.descendant_concept_id = 103 AND ca.ancestor_concept_id <> 103 AND ca.min_levels_of_separation <= 5 GROUP BY ca.ancestor_concept_id UNION ALL SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id, MIN(ca.min_levels_of_separation) AS level FROM concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 103 AND ca.descendant_concept_id <> 103 AND ca.min_levels_of_separation <= 5 GROUP BY ca.descendant_concept_id UNION ALL SELECT 103 AS concept_id, 0 AS level) h JOIN concept c ON c.concept_id = h.concept_id ORDER BY abs(h.level), h.level, c.concept_id LIMIT 150

WITH RECURSIVE up(concept_id, depth) AS (SELECT ca.ancestor_concept_id, 1 FROM concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.min_levels_of_separation = 1 AND ca.descendant_concept_id = 109 UNION SELECT ca.ancestor_concept_id, up.depth + 1 FROM concept_ancestor ca JOIN up ON ca.descendant_concept_id = up.concept_id WHERE ca.min_levels_of_separation = 1 AND up.depth < 2), down(concept_id, depth) AS (SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id, 1 FROM concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.min_levels_of_separation = 1 AND ca.ancestor_concept_id = 109 UNION SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id, down.depth + 1 FROM concept_ancestor ca JOIN down ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = down.concept_id WHERE ca.min_levels_of_separation = 1 AND down.depth < 2) SELECT c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.domain_id, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_class_id, c.standard_concept, c.concept_code, CAST(c.valid_start_date AS VARCHAR) AS valid_start_date, CAST(c.valid_end_date AS VARCHAR) AS valid_end_date, c.invalid_reason, h.level AS hierarchy_level FROM (SELECT concept_id, -MIN(depth) AS level FROM up WHERE concept_id <> 109 GROUP BY concept_id UNION ALL SELECT concept_id, MIN(depth) AS level FROM down WHERE concept_id <> 109 GROUP BY concept_id UNION ALL SELECT 109 AS concept_id, 0 AS level) h JOIN concept c ON c.concept_id = h.concept_id ORDER BY abs(h.level), h.level, c.concept_id LIMIT 4

SELECT c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.domain_id, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_class_id, c.standard_concept, c.concept_code, CAST(c.valid_start_date AS VARCHAR) AS valid_start_date, CAST(c.valid_end_date AS VARCHAR) AS valid_end_date, c.invalid_reason, h.level AS hierarchy_level FROM (SELECT ca.ancestor_concept_id AS concept_id, -MIN(ca.min_levels_of_separation) AS level FROM concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.descendant_concept_id = 109 AND ca.ancestor_concept_id <> 109 AND ca.min_levels_of_separation <= 2 GROUP BY ca.ancestor_concept_id UNION ALL SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id, MIN(ca.min_levels_of_separation) AS level FROM concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 109 AND ca.descendant_concept_id <> 109 AND ca.min_levels_of_separation <= 2 GROUP BY ca.descendant_concept_id UNION ALL SELECT 109 AS concept_id, 0 AS level) h JOIN concept c ON c.concept_id = h.concept_id ORDER BY abs(h.level), h.level, c.concept_id LIMIT 4

WITH RECURSIVE up(concept_id, depth) AS (SELECT ca.ancestor_concept_id, 1 FROM concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.min_levels_of_separation = 1 AND ca.descendant_concept_id = 103 UNION SELECT ca.ancestor_concept_id, up.depth + 1 FROM concept_ancestor ca JOIN up ON ca.descendant_concept_id = up.concept_id WHERE ca.min_levels_of_separation = 1 AND up.depth < 10), down(concept_id, depth) AS (SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id, 1 FROM concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.min_levels_of_separation = 1 AND ca.ancestor_concept_id = 103 UNION SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id, down.depth + 1 FROM concept_ancestor ca JOIN down ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = down.concept_id WHERE ca.min_levels_of_separation = 1 AND down.depth < 10) SELECT c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.domain_id, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_class_id, c.standard_concept, c.concept_code, CAST(c.valid_start_date AS VARCHAR) AS valid_start_date, CAST(c.valid_end_date AS VARCHAR) AS valid_end_date, c.invalid_reason, h.level AS hierarchy_level FROM (SELECT concept_id, -MIN(depth) AS level FROM up WHERE concept_id <> 103 GROUP BY concept_id UNION ALL SELECT concept_id, MIN(depth) AS level FROM down WHERE concept_id <> 103 GROUP BY concept_id UNION ALL SELECT 103 AS concept_id, 0 AS level) h JOIN concept c ON c.concept_id = h.concept_id ORDER BY abs(h.level), h.level, c.concept_id LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT ca.ancestor_concept_id AS from_id, ca.descendant_concept_id AS to_id FROM concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.min_levels_of_separation = 1 AND ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (102, 103, 104) AND ca.descendant_concept_id IN (102, 103, 104) ORDER BY from_id, to_id
SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (102, 110) AND ca.descendant_concept_id <> ca.ancestor_concept_id

WITH RECURSIVE d(concept_id) AS (SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.min_levels_of_separation = 1 AND ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (102, 110) UNION SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor ca JOIN d ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = d.concept_id WHERE ca.min_levels_of_separation = 1) SELECT DISTINCT concept_id FROM d
SELECT DISTINCT cr.concept_id_2 AS concept_id FROM concept_relationship cr WHERE cr.concept_id_1 IN (104, 200) AND cr.relationship_id IN ('Maps to', 'Mapped from')
SELECT c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.domain_id, c.concept_class_id, c.concept_code, c.standard_concept FROM concept c WHERE c.concept_id IN (103, 300)
SELECT vocabulary_id, vocabulary_version FROM vocabulary WHERE vocabulary_version IS NOT NULL ORDER BY vocabulary_id
SELECT DISTINCT domain_id AS value FROM concept WHERE domain_id IS NOT NULL AND domain_id <> '' ORDER BY value
